text.en: Raju saw a family receiving free rice at a ration shop. "Why is that?" he asked.

Food security means that all people have enough safe and nutritious food at all times. It needs food availability, access and the ability to absorb it. Poverty, droughts and rising prices threaten it.
In India the Public Distribution System (PDS) supplies food grains at low prices through ration shops, and the Food Corporation of India keeps buffer stocks. The National Food Security Act of 2013 gives subsidised grain to many families.
Tamil Nadu runs a universal PDS and a noon meal scheme. Nutrition is also a part: balanced diet, protein, vitamins and minerals prevent malnutrition and stunting.

problem.en: How does the PDS help the poor?

text.en: It gives grain at low prices.

prompt.en: A friend says Food security means only having rice. How will you reply?

requiredIdeas.en: It needs enough nutritious food for all.

points.en: Food security: access to enough food.
